metric_name: 用水效益目标设定与行动方案
query: 用水效益目标设定与行动方案 用水效益目标设定与行动方案 衡量企业是否针对节约用水、提高水利用率订立了明确的目标，并披露了为达成这些目标所采取的工程技术手段、管理措施或循环利用方案。 A. 目标设定得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了量化的用水目标及时间表（如“2027年实现单位产值耗水量下降15%”）。 1分：仅披露定性或愿景式目标（如“致力于减少生产用水，提高回用率”）。 0分：未提及任何用水目标。 B. 执行步骤得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了具体的节水措施或技术（如“安装中水回用系统”、“升级冷却塔节水设备”）。 1分：仅笼统提及“加强用水管理”或“推广节水意识”。 0分：无行动方案。 最终得分 = 0.5×A+0.5×B 用水效益目标 用水强度下降 节水目标 中水回用 水循环利用 闭环用水 冷却系统节水 单位产值耗水量 water efficiency target water intensity reduction water conservation target reclaimed water reuse water recycling closed-loop water system cooling water saving unit water consumption 企业是否披露量化用水或节水目标及时间表？ 基准年与目标年分别是什么？ 采取了哪些工程技术手段（如中水回用、冷却系统改造）？ 是否披露循环利用率、回用率或单位产值耗水量指标？ 管理措施如何支撑目标达成？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '用水效益目标设定与行动方案'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露量化用水或节水目标及时间表？ 基准年与目标年分别是什么？ 采取了哪些工程技术手段（如中水回用、冷却系统改造）？ 是否披露循环利用率、回用率或单位产值耗水量指标？ 管理措施如何支撑目标达成？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有水风险评估而无节水目标或行动；仅有排放水质达标；仅有社区节水宣传；仅有历史节水绩效且无前瞻目标或行动。不得排除定性节水目标、笼统用水管理意向，或未与目标显式绑定的具体节水、回用措施：它们可分别支持目标设定或执行步骤的低档/高档证据。区分：本指标分别评价用水效益目标和执行步骤；水风险评估不能替代二者。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Environmental Protection
results.text: Water consumption of the Group is sourced from municipal water supply. During the Reporting Period, the Group did not have any issues in sourcing water. Although the Group is not a waterintensive industry as our water consumption is primarily for domestic use, we have nevertheless seized every opportunity to reduce the consumption of precious water resources. At office, we install water-saving faucets and encourage employees to be careful of their water consumption by posting water conservation signs in restrooms.

Environmental Protection

[Content]
Water consumption of the Group is sourced from municipal water supply. During the Reporting Period, the Group did not have any issues in sourcing water. Although the Group is not a waterintensive industry as our water consumption is primarily for domestic use, we have nevertheless seized every opportunity to reduce the consumption of precious water resources. At office, we install water-saving faucets and encourage employees to be careful of their water consumption by posting water conservation signs in restrooms.

results.section: Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery
results.text: Aiming to achieve environmental improvements, the Group looks into every possibility for energy saving and emissions reduction during our business operation. The Group implemented multiple energy conservation initiatives, such as promoting energy conservation behaviour in the workplace and adopting energy-efficient equipment. The Group also regularly inspects and maintains the conditions of the machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels in order to ensure that they are operating at optimum conditions. In addition, we assign dedicated personnel for energy consumption monitoring and recording to identify anomalies.

[Content]
Aiming to achieve environmental improvements, the Group looks into every possibility for energy saving and emissions reduction during our business operation. The Group implemented multiple energy conservation initiatives, such as promoting energy conservation behaviour in the workplace and adopting energy-efficient equipment. The Group also regularly inspects and maintains the conditions of the machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels in order to ensure that they are operating at optimum conditions. In addition, we assign dedicated personnel for energy consumption monitoring and recording to identify anomalies.

results.section: Environmental Protection
results.text: Wastewater discharge management is also an important way to preserve water resources. As our cargo terminals are located in coastal areas, the Group pays extra attention to wastewater discharge. Wastewater treatment facilities were built with careful planning to divert all wastewater within the boundary of cargo terminals to the treatment facilities for proper treatment before discharge. Apart from this, the wastewater is collected at the terminal to prevent wastewater discharge and pollution in the nearby coastal region.

[Content]
Wastewater discharge management is also an important way to preserve water resources. As our cargo terminals are located in coastal areas, the Group pays extra attention to wastewater discharge. Wastewater treatment facilities were built with careful planning to divert all wastewater within the boundary of cargo terminals to the treatment facilities for proper treatment before discharge.
